centro: Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center / UTHealth Houston (McGovern Medical School) - Dept. of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery
alerta_correcao: Gustavo Oderich NÃO está mais na UTHealth/Memorial Hermann. Foi chefe de vascular e diretor do Aortic Center na UTHealth de 2020 até ~2024/2025; desde fev/2025 está no Baylor College of Medicine/Texas Heart Institute (ver centro 3). Chefe atual da Divisão de Cirurgia Vascular da UTHealth: Joseph DuBose (efetivo 1/set; anúncio datado 2026-09-02).

observership_ut.nome: UTHealth Houston Visiting Scholars Program (VSP) - trilha Observer
trechos: To apply as an Observer, the Applicant must first identify a Faculty Sponsor at UTHealth Houston who agrees to host the Observer.
An Observer may not begin their visit until receiving the approval email from the Visiting Scholars Program, and all onboarding processes are complete.
It is the responsibility of non-U.S. citizens/permanent residents to have a visa appropriate to be an Observer at UTHealth Houston.
Once the application is submitted to the VSP Office, the applicant will receive an email with a link to complete the Health History Questionnaire and upload the required health records.
observership_ut.elegibilidade: Estrangeiros aceitos como Observers desde que tenham faculty sponsor e visto adequado; sem contato com paciente. Não há regra explícita sobre residente estrangeiro encontrada.
observership_ut.taxa: Conflitante: guideline cita US$100 para observer doméstico; FAQ da Neurologia cita US$775 de taxa universitária para Foreign nationals (https://med.uth.edu/neurology/education/observership/frequently-asked-questions-faqs/) + taxa departamental própria da Neuro. Confirmar com VSP.
observership_ut.documentos: Health History Questionnaire + registros de vacinas/testes; treinamentos obrigatórios (assédio, HIPAA) antes do início; visto adequado (provável B1/B2 - não explicitado).
observership_ut.inicio_pelo: Departamento inicia a aplicação online após o sponsor aceitar.

programa.nome: Houston Methodist Global Health Care Education - Observerships
trechos: Observerships must be requested and initiated by a Houston Methodist physician.
typically two to four weeks in length and does not include direct patient care
The observer, preceptor and department administrator will complete the Houston Methodist Global Observership Agreement form.
Because this is not a hands-on experience, Houston Methodist physicians cannot provide letters or recommendation or complete evaluation forms for observers.
If you are interested in observing a Houston Methodist physician, please submit your inquiry to HMObserver@houstonmethodist.org
